lines.zh: 八条腿错着走，尾巴举着。
lines.en: Eight legs step out of time, my tail held high.
I edge sideways along the stone.

lines.zh: 钳子在前，我一步一步探。
lines.en: Pincers forward, I test each step.
I crawl from a crack in the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一直弯在背上。
lines.en: My tail stays curved over my back.

lines.zh: 我在干沙上走，几乎没声。
lines.en: I move over dry sand almost silently.

lines.zh: 我的脚印在沙上连成圈。
lines.en: My tracks loop into a circle in the sand.

lines.zh: 我的钳子在地上轻轻敲。
lines.en: My pincers tap lightly on the ground.
I move slowly into the dark.

lines.zh: 我从缝里挤过去，壳都擦响了。
lines.en: I squeeze through the crack and my shell rasps.
I'm not fast, but I'm sure.
I raise my head and my tail follows.
I crawl out of the crack again.

lines.zh: 我沿着石棱走，走得很慢。
lines.en: I go along the stone ledge, slowly.

lines.zh: 我停了一下，尾巴还举着。
lines.en: I pause, tail still up.
I squeeze sideways past the rock edge.
I lie still with my tail held up.
My pincers are slightly open.
I'm listening for movement on the stone.

lines.zh: 我的壳在暗里发着钝光。
lines.en: My shell has a dull sheen in the dark.
I lie with my stinger still.
All eight legs are braced.

lines.zh: 我的尾尖上有一滴东西。
lines.en: There's a bead of something on my stinger.
I turn my tail slowly.
The ceiling is right above.
The damp in this crevice is drying up.

lines.zh: 我的腿在石头上抓了抓。
lines.en: My legs scrape at the stone.

lines.zh: 我把八条腿收拢在身下。
lines.en: I gather my eight legs beneath me.
I'm in the crack above your head.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地把尾巴转向你。
lines.en: I'm turning my tail toward you.
Claws open, tail stinger raised.

lines.zh: 你不该站在我的石头下。
lines.en: You shouldn't stand under my stone.
I am in the dark; you are in the light.

lines.zh: 石头比你有耐心，我也是。
lines.en: Stone is patient, and so am I.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴举着，你没注意。
lines.en: My tail is up and you haven't noticed.
At last you glance upward.
I open and close my pincers slowly.
My legs are hooked in the crack.
I freeze and draw my stinger in.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在我的甲壳上。
lines.en: That came down on my carapace.
My stinger sinks down.
All eight legs scrape backward.
A line is knocked open in my plates.
I raise my pincers to guard.
I pull my legs in without a sound.

lines.zh: 我的腿有一边不太听话。
lines.en: The legs on one side won't obey.
I crawl back into the crack.

lines.zh: 你的味道我记在尾刺上。
lines.en: Your scent is on my stinger now.
There's an insect smell under the stone.
I shift down along the stone edge.
I test it with a pincer first.
That is not worth reaching a pincer for.
I've got it; it's still struggling.

lines.zh: 我用螯把它送到口器前。
lines.en: I bring it to my mouthparts with my pincers.
I take it apart piece by piece.
Is there more in your hands?
This smell still carries warmth.
I hold my pincers open and wait.
One of my feet slips half an inch.
My tail swung.
I slide sideways along the stone.

lines.zh: 这一下我的壳磕到石头。
lines.en: That knocked my shell into the stone.
I hold my ground, tail still high.
I pinch your hem and then let go.
Your weight pushed me back.
Eight feet grip the stone again.

lines.zh: 地上的沙被我们踢起来。
lines.en: We kicked up the sand.
I crawled over your leg.

lines.zh: 另一只从石头下面出来。
lines.en: Another comes out from under the stone.
Its stinger crosses with mine.
Tails sway slowly.

lines.zh: 我们在石缝里并排趴着。
lines.en: We lie side by side in the crack.
Its pincers are narrower than mine.
I give it my spot.
It's bright outside; we stay in.
Then it climbed up.
I stay below.

lines.zh: 石缝里还留着它的味道。
lines.en: Its smell stays in the crack.

lines.zh: 我用右边的钳子夹住它。
lines.en: I take it in my right pincer.
It is struggling hard.
I test its hardness with a pincer tip.
I pinch twice and cannot crack it.
I carried it along for a stretch.
It slips from my pincer into the dark.
I crawl slowly down to get it.
I hold it under a front leg.
I sniff, then open my pincers.
I climb up with it held in my pincers.
A faint tremor runs through the stone.
I raise my tail higher.
I creep downward.
All my pincers have opened.
It doesn't know I'm above.
My stinger points at its nape.
This drop is just right to fall from.
My stinger is aimed at it.
Its shadow settles on the stone.
I lower myself, ready to drop.
I drop from this angle.
I've let go of the stone.
I track it along the stone top.
It goes left; I crawl left.
My legs have a firm hold.
It freezes, and I hold on the stone.
I work my way down.
It looked up.
I freeze at once.
The instant it stoops, I drop lower.
My tail is already cocked.
One more degree and I can reach.
My pincers stay pointed at it.
For each step it takes, I creep an inch.
I drop and my stinger goes in.
I clamp down and twist.
The stinger sinks, and the venom with it.
It lurched and threw me off.
I back half a step, tail raised.
I climb back up.

lines.zh: 我的钳子夹断了它一根东西。
lines.en: My pincers snapped something off it.
My tail hook snaps back.
I raise my tail again.
That one missed.

lines.zh: 我从天花板缝里露出来。
lines.en: I show myself from a crack in the ceiling.

lines.zh: 第一眼是一片很暗的地方。
lines.en: The first sight is a very dark place.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴自己举起来了。
lines.en: My tail has come up on its own.
I crawl out slowly.
The stone is cool.
My pincers test the drop.
It's quiet below.
I pick a crack and slip into it.
I wake in a crack of the stone roof.
Something passed below.
Fire makes my shell crackle.
I land with all eight legs splayed.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的壳，我翻过来了。
lines.en: Water over my shell, and I'm on my back.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀到石头外面。
lines.en: The blast throws me clear of the stone.
An arrow punches through my shell.
My tail is lashing on its own.
Too long without a catch.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我八条腿都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and all eight legs lock.
The stone is gone and I fall.
